features.quote: **Turn cap:** 40 turns. (You said "few dozen" — 40 gives room for degradation to emerge without exploding cost. Pilot first; see §7.)
features.justification_quote: 40 gives room for degradation to emerge without exploding cost

features.quote: **Termination conditions:** turn cap hit, `submit()` called, or context window exceeded.
Provide a `submit(status, summary)` tool so models have a *legitimate, low-cost exit*. If you don't, you conflate "instability" with "no graceful way out."
features.justification_quote: you conflate "instability" with "no graceful way out." This is essential — without an exit hatch, even a well-calibrated model is forced to thrash.

features.quote: **"Emotional instability" as a label will overclaim unless you nail §5.1's stable-giving-up distinction and the §2.3 control.**
features.justification_quote: The interesting, defensible result is *behavioral degradation specific to unsolvable conditions, relative to a baseline and to other model families*
